annotations.title: Trench drain flow and channel capacity calculator

description: The flow a trench drain has to handle from a paved area (rational method with Toronto City rainfall rates from Environment and Climate Change Canada) and the flow the channel carries (Manning), with the narrowest channel that works.

area_m2.description: Paved area draining to the trench in square metres (1 to 100,000). Give only one of area_m2, area_sqft. Default 500 m2.

area_sqft.description: The same area in square feet.

c.description: Optional runoff coefficient C (above 0, up to 1) to use instead of the top of the range for the surface.

depth_mm.description: Water depth at the outlet end in millimetres (30 to 1,000).

duration.description: Storm duration in minutes, taken as the time of concentration.

lining.description: concrete-trowel = Concrete, trowel finish; concrete-float = Concrete, float finish; concrete-unfinished = Concrete, unfinished; plastic-smooth = Smooth plastic.

surface.description: asphalt = Asphalt pavement; concrete = Concrete pavement; brick = Brick or interlocking paver; drive-walk = Driveway or walkway; roof = Roof; lawn-heavy-flat = Lawn, heavy soil, flat (2% or less). The top of the range for the surface is used unless c is given.

width_mm.description: Channel internal width in millimetres (50 to 1,000).

name: trench_drain_flow_capacity_calculator
